summary: Iteration 6 - DutyConnect M3c (payment-clash + public pages) frontend E2E, viewport 390x844, user delivered+t1@resend.dev. Seeded clashes via POST /api/shifts/sync (helper /app/test_reports/seed_m3c_clash.py). All in-scope flows PASS. (1) EDIT CLASH: Pushed shift with payments [£100 deleted:true, pa=£150 origin=p1, pb=£120 origin=p1]. Server returned payment_clash=true, amount_received=£120. After login the app showed home-provisional-banner with exact text 'Provisional figures: a payment was edited differently on two devices on 1 shift. Open the shift and choose the correct payment.', earnings-provisional-banner with same copy, earnings-received=£120.00 (lower amount counted once, not £270), and shift-card-provisional-<id> pill in History. Opening the shift via shift-card-<id> rendered payment-clash-panel-edit with payment-clash-option-<pa.id>=£150 AND payment-clash-option-<pb.id>=£120, two 'Keep this' buttons. Tapping payment-clash-keep-<pa.id> opened payment-clash-confirm whose body named both amounts ('Count £150.00 as the correct payment? The other version (£120.00) will stop counting but stay in your history.'); payment-clash-cancel returned to the choice list (confirm box dismissed). Second Keep + payment-clash-confirm-button then synced: panel-edit removed, payments-received=£150.00, payments-history-note shows '1 earlier version kept in history and not counted (replaced by your confirmed choice).' Back on the list the shift-card-provisional pill is gone, home-provisional-banner gone, earnings-provisional-banner gone, earnings-received=£150.00. (2) DECISION CLASH: Pushed two decisions (keep pa / keep pb) at the same base_version via sync. Server returned payment_clash=true, amount_received=£120. The shift details rendered payment-clash-panel-decision whose heading is 'Different choices made on two devices' (verbatim) with both £120 and £150 options and 'Keep this' buttons. Picking one + confirm resolves the panel-decision immediately. (3) ACCOUNT TAB: account-privacy-row, account-terms-row, account-deleted-row and account-export-row all present. account-privacy-row opens a new tab to /api/public/privacy ('Privacy Policy' in body=True); account-terms-row opens /api/public/terms (verified). account-export-row opens export-sheet (then export-close-button). account-deleted-row navigates to recently-deleted-screen. (4) PUBLIC PAGES (no login): /api/public/privacy, /api/public/terms and /api/public/delete-account all 200 with mobile viewport meta and expected titles. On /api/public/delete-account step 1 with 'nobody123@example.com' advanced to step 2 (6-digit code field + consent checkbox visible — same response for unknown emails). Confirming code '000000' WITHOUT checkbox showed the inline error 'Tick the box to confirm you understand.'. After ticking checkbox and resubmitting the same bad code, the page displayed 'That code is invalid or has expired. Request a new code and try again.' (console 400 as expected). Main test account was NOT deleted. (5) REGRESSION: Login (login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button), tabs (tab-home/tab-shifts/tab-earnings/tab-account), History + List view, SyncBadge 'Synced', shift-card metadata and provisional pill all behave as before. Minor note: the toast element 'Choice saved' was not caught by the Playwright locator after the final confirm (likely dismissed by the time inspection ran); the state transition (panel gone, received = £150.00, history-note present) confirms the sync completed successfully. No React Native red screens, no new deprecated-package usage. Carryover console warnings only: shadow* → boxShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents (both pre-existing from iteration 1).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' - persists on auth/home screens. Not pinpointed by RN warning stack; likely /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx or ./shift-card.tsx shadow blocks.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - persists; likely from react-native-reanimated / react-native-screens wrapper.

test_report_links: /app/test_reports/seed_m3c_clash.py (helper to seed EDIT and DECISION clashes via /api/shifts/sync and cleanup)
action_items: No functional M3c frontend defects found. Edit-clash, Decision-clash, Account rows (privacy/terms/export/deleted) and public privacy/terms/delete-account pages all behave to spec.
Nice-to-have: migrate residual shadow* -> boxShadow and prop pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents to silence the two carryover console warnings (iteration 1 carryover; not M3c scope).
Nice-to-have: show the 'Choice saved - it will sync to your other devices' toast for a slightly longer window or add a toast testID so it can be asserted after resolvePaymentClash() resolves.
critical_code_review_comments: payment-clash.tsx:19-27 Correctly selects panel kind: 'decision' | 'edit' | 'pending' and shows the right wording — the runtime matched both 'Payment edited on two devices' (edit) and 'Different choices made on two devices' (decision) verbatim.
payment-clash.tsx:50-55 Confirm copy enumerates every other candidate amount (£150 and £120 both named in UI test) — matches spec requirement that users see every competing version before confirming.

payments-panel.tsx:30-31 'active' filter (groups where kind==='none') correctly hides unresolved candidates from the regular rows and shows them only inside PaymentClash — avoids double-counting; stats.ts summing lower-once-only (£120) was verified at runtime (home + earnings pre-resolution).

payments-panel.tsx:120-123 payments-history-note reads '1 earlier version kept in history and not counted (replaced by your confirmed choice).' — exact wording required by spec ('1 earlier version is kept').

account.tsx:16 openPublic uses WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync which on web dispatches window.open — Playwright caught the new tab for both privacy and terms rows, confirming the public pages are reachable without login.

public delete-account page correctly: (a) advances to step 2 for an unknown email (indistinguishable from a known one), (b) blocks confirm without the checkbox with 'Tick the box to confirm you understand.', (c) rejects a wrong code with 'That code is invalid or has expired. Request a new code and try again.' — matches test_m3c.py::TestAccountDeletion requirements.

success_rate.backend: N/A this iteration (skipped per request; previous run 122/122)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on everything in-scope for this iteration — edit-clash UI (banners, pill, panel-edit, options, confirm text, cancel, confirm-button, history-note, totals pre/post), decision-clash UI (panel-decision with exact wording and resolution), Account rows (privacy, terms, export, deleted), public privacy/terms/delete-account pages with mobile viewport, unknown-email step-2 advance, no-checkbox error, wrong-code 'invalid or expired' message. Account was NOT deleted.

seed_data_creation: Several M3c clash shifts were created during testing and then cleaned up at the end (/app/test_reports/seed_m3c_clash.py cleanup → cleaned: 5). Main test account state restored (no residual clash shifts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server date is 2026-10-12 (not Jan 2026 as the system prompt header says). Login flow needs an extra click on 'Sign in' (the entry screen shows a hero + Create account / Sign in buttons). Auth testIDs are login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button (NOT auth-*). Tab testIDs tab-home / tab-shifts / tab-earnings / tab-account. The shift details page is a modal sheet; after resolving an in-sheet panel, close the sheet first (go_back or outside tap) before clicking tab-* otherwise the overlay will intercept. account-privacy-row / account-terms-row use WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync which on web resolves to window.open — assert the new tab via page.context.expect_page. The seed helper /app/test_reports/seed_m3c_clash.py takes 'edit' / 'decision' / 'cleanup' and prints a JSON summary (shift_id, payment ids, server amount_received, payment_clash). It auto-cleans before seeding so you can re-run freely.
rca_of_issue: No defects identified. M3c scope — payment-clash panels (edit + decision), explicit confirmation naming every competing amount, provisional banners on Home + Earnings, lower-amount-counted-once arithmetic, immutable payment history (payments-history-note after confirm), Account public-page launchers and the three public no-login pages (privacy / terms / delete-account) with unknown-email + no-checkbox + wrong-code states — behave exactly as the spec requires.
